map.：若笔试→面试仅 15% 而行业 30%，提示题面过难或岗位匹配错位，优先优化笔: : If the written test to interview rate is only 15% against an industry figure of 30%, it suggests the questions are too hard or the role match is misaligned, so optimise the written test first.
